alt: 居民拿著工廠排放污水的照片發言，旁邊有人伏案撰寫文章，眾人皺眉查看證據。
scene_prompt: An original community investigation scene in one coherent room: left, an eyewitness publicly speaks into a simple microphone and points at a clear photo of a factory pipe secretly pouring dark waste into a river; center, a writer writes a critical article with pen on several documents covered in indistinct graphite writing texture, absolutely no readable words; right, concerned citizens examine the same pollution photo and react with disapproval. Verbal denunciation and written exposure target the clearly shown wrongful pollution. No weapons, no blank meaningless sheets.
